profiles.name: Mordi Bimol
profiles.position: Deputy Minister of Youth and Sports
profiles.description: Mordi Bimol represents Mas Gading, Sarawak, in the Dewan Rakyat. Current role: Deputy Minister of Youth and Sports. Affiliated with DAP.

profiles.name: Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen
profiles.description: Kelvin Yii Lee Wuen represents Bandar Kuching, Sarawak, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with DAP.

profiles.name: Chong Chieng Jen
profiles.description: Chong Chieng Jen represents Stampin, Sarawak, in the Dewan Rakyat. Affiliated with DAP.

milestones.title: Complete six youth-budget consultation stops
milestones.description: Mordi reported three of six Jelajah Kita Dengar consultation stops completed, with Sabah, the Southern Zone and Sarawak still scheduled.
milestones.progress_note: Progress is 3 completed stops / 6 planned stops = 50%, as reported on 19 September. This is a historical event-count snapshot. The remaining stops and delivery of a memorandum to the Prime Minister were not verified; their scheduled dates do not prove completion.

milestones.title: Provide RM100,000 for Sarawak General Hospital equipment and facilities
milestones.description: Kelvin’s office reported handing over the allocation for computers, seating and other essential hospital equipment.
milestones.progress_note: The dated party report establishes the funding handover, not completed procurement, installed equipment or measured clinical improvements. The exact earlier handover day is not specified.

milestones.title: Publish the reported use of RM4.2 million in 2025 constituency allocations
milestones.description: Kelvin released his 2025 report card, describing education, healthcare, welfare and community initiatives funded from the constituency allocation.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers publication of the report card. Spending figures are the MP’s reported 2025 totals, not an independent audit or a November 2026 measurement. The education budget share is not a completion percentage.

milestones.title: Equip national-school classrooms in Stampin with smart TVs
milestones.description: Chong set a goal to extend the classroom digital-teaching initiative to 15 primary and three secondary national schools by 2026, or at the latest 2027.
milestones.progress_note: The 30 September follow-up reports allocations for SK Satria Jaya and SK Sungai Stutong, with some Primary One classrooms still needing equipment. These school-specific figures do not establish all-constituency completion. The outer year-only deadline uses 31 December 2027; the earlier 2026 ambition is retained here.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
